song_craft: Chewing seal song (21v, rasa = bliss-as-chewing): catalogue-bow (v1, nathaM obscure kept) -> self-forgetting feast (v2) -> Hara-housed (v3) -> played-lordship (v4) -> bliss-birth (v5) -> Gauri-lover hinge (v6) -> creepers-tree (v7) -> itch-born worship (v8) -> ever-sport bow (v9) -> nowhither bow-bow (v10) -> begged-what (v11) -> turns-road (v12) -> sink-How (v13) -> awaited-light (v14) -> lip-Śiva (v15) -> relish-her (v16) -> guzzled-world (v17) -> graveyard-sport (v18, Swamiji) -> thought-standing (v19) -> night-dance (v20) -> SEAL no-end praise (v21). The treatise ends by refusing to end.
